source_state: Uncommitted worktree; code overlays include earlier tank-driving work.
notes: Ordinary seed-42 hills reproduce the manual report. The exact live screenshot state was not extracted; its game had advanced before being paused.
Each tuning comparison starts a new deterministic scene with the same seed and input schedule. It is not a same-native-state fork; altered movement changes later shots and terrain.
Finish means chassis X >= 8, positive health and live support. Reports continue to the end of the fixed 40-second input schedule; later events are outside hill-crossing success.
Quiet parks the opponent and suppresses future fire at initialization. Combat uses its existing driving, aim and firing policies.
The two-second hill stops are at X=-10, -6 and -2. Finish times include all three stops and exclude two seconds of initial settling.
Torque 300 and motor damping 240 replace 120/80. Braking torque, target speed, acceleration ramp, wheel geometry/mass, suspension and native support gates remain fixed.
All benchmark material audits and replays pass. Rigid fixtures and explicit old wheel settings reproduce earlier hashes; new wheel settings intentionally alter observations.
Benchmark timings are single local samples on different evolving workloads, not an isolated motor-performance comparison.
Rover Lab and Spacewars rover defaults are unchanged by this correction.
